design_decisions_required.decision: Approve or replace the four-bar trend/pullback/trigger definition and support/resistance anchor ownership.
Approve measured compression range versus traded breakout boundary hierarchy and threshold unit semantics.
Decide whether VWAP rejection is a real strategy behavior or naming-only legacy.

compression-breakout.current_main_summary: Entry point uses profile gates, session range-width fraction, ATR ratio, optional compression-regime boost, and nearest/ORB/day breakout levels.
design_ambiguities: Strategy spec must approve relationship between measured compression range and traded breakout boundary hierarchy.
MAX_RANGE_WIDTH_PCT is a fraction threshold per current owner despite pct naming.

opening-range-retest.current_main_summary: Entry point validates completed 1m history, builds OR from first 15 bars, scans breakout then retest then terminal continuation; stale snapshot claim is superseded.
objective_defects: retest_distance_pct is computed from breakout_bar.close rather than retest_bar.close, so the evidence/scoring name does not match the retest event.

trend-pullback.current_main_summary: Entry point resolves required profile, validates completed history, and applies a four-bar trend/pullback/trigger contract against support or resistance with no VWAP anchor fallback.
design_ambiguities: Approved strategy intent must decide whether the four-bar window is sufficient and whether support/resistance ownership is the final anchor model.

vwap-reclaim.current_main_summary: Entry point validates completed history, computes causal VWAP, requires ctx.vwap to match final causal VWAP, and tests establishment/reclaim/hold sequence.
design_ambiguities: Decide whether rejection is in scope; if yes define an explicit rejection predicate, otherwise rename labels/spec.
objective_defects: Candidate labels say reclaim_or_rejection, but source contains no distinct rejection predicate beyond bullish/bearish reclaim/cross sequence.

objective_repairs_required.repair: Compute retest_distance_pct from retest_bar.close against retest_level, or rename the field if the intended value is breakout-bar boundary distance.
Either add an approved explicit VWAP rejection predicate with tests or remove rejection wording from candidate labels/spec.
